fields.label: Where will you be based? *
fields._note: RE-VERIFIED against the live DOM 2026-08-24 after an earlier fixture draft inferred a label mentioning 'work authorisation' that the real form does not contain. The real label says nothing about eligibility — only the OPTIONS do. This is the exact case buildFillPlan's options-based eligibility scan exists for: label-only detection would have silently fallen through to a generic 'unrecognised field' ask, which is still SAFE (nothing gets filled wrong) but mislabels why.
options: Netherlands, already authorized to work here
In the EU/EEA, authorized without VISA sponsorship
In the UK, authorized without VISA sponsorship
Outside the EU/UK, remote, within 2 hours of Central European Time
Outside the EU/UK, remote, more than 3 hours from Central European Time
Anywhere, but I would need visa sponsorship

fields.label: What is your salary indication (gross annual incl. holiday allowance in EUR)? *
How many years of professional software experience do you have shipping products/features? Internships, freelance and contract work all count. *
Think of something you've built that you're proud of. Who actually used it? *
options: Only me, or it was a course/class assignment
Friends, classmates, or a hackathon demo but not maintained afterwards
A team inside a company I worked at, running in production
Paying customers or external users, running in production
A public product with an ongoing user base that I still maintain

fields.label: On the last feature or product you shipped, how was the decision made about what to build? *
options: It came to me as a ticket or spec and I implemented it
I was handed a problem and I decided how to solve it
I found the problem myself, pitched it, then built it
I found it, built it, and decided what to cut in order to ship on time

fields.label: Which best describes how you use AI in your day-to-day work right now? *
options: Rarely, or just inline autocomplete suggestions
A chat assistant I ask questions and copy code out of
An agent in my editor for multi-file changes, and I review every diff
Agents do most of my implementation; I write the spec, review, and correct
